# Power and Sample Size for Genetic Association Studies

paweh

Plan genetic association studies before collecting data. Estimate power
or the sample size you need under assumptions about genetic
heterogeneity, genotype error, and phenotype misclassification.

[Get
Started](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-01-getting-started.md)
[Study Designs](#study-designs) [Methods &
Sources](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-08-methods-and-sources.md)
[Function
Reference](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/index.md)

## What can paweh calculate?

Both calculations start with a proposed effect and a planned statistical
test. In this [worked
example](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-01-getting-started.md),
the two calculations use the same case-control assumptions and genotype
chi-square test.

### How much power does my study have?

98.52% power

With 500 cases and 500 controls, this is the chance the test detects the
assumed association.

### How many participants do I need?

482 participants

For 80% power, recruit 241 cases and 241 controls. In a family study,
plan for complete trios instead.

## Choose your study design

Start with the people you can recruit and the measurements you expect to
collect.

- ### [Case-Control Studies](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-02-case-control-study-design.md)

  Plan how many people with and without a condition to recruit for a
  comparison of genotypes.

- ### [TDT / Family Studies](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-03-tdt-study-design.md)

  Plan a study of affected children and both biological parents using
  informative allele transmissions.

- ### [Quantitative Traits](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-04-quantitative-trait-study-design.md)

  Plan a study of measurements such as height. Compare a full sample,
  selected extremes, or several traits.

- ### [Sequencing-Based Studies](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-06-sequencing-study-design.md)

  Compare how sequencing depth and read errors affect recruitment for
  case-control studies and trios.

- ### [Validation-Based / LRTae Studies](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-07-lrtae-study-design.md)

  Plan how many people to recruit when only some receive a reference
  diagnosis or a confirmatory genotype assay.

- ### [Hardy–Weinberg Equilibrium](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-09-hwe-diagnostics.md)

  Check genotype counts for departures from equilibrium and plan how
  many individuals you need to detect a specified departure.

- ### [Interactive Dashboard](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-05-interactive-dashboard.md)

  Explore case-control, trio, and quantitative-trait designs in a Shiny
  interface.

[Browse all
articles](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/index.md)

## Install and get started

paweh is currently available from GitHub. The package has yet to be
released on CRAN. Install the stable `main` branch with the command
below.

    remotes::install_github("akilanthony/paweh", ref = "main")

Install `remotes` first if needed. For the current development package
and all nine articles, see the `develop` installation in [Getting
Started](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-01-getting-started.md).

## Methodological foundation

[![Springer cover of Heterogeneity in Statistical Genetics by Derek
Gordon, Stephen J. Finch, and Wonkuk
Kim](reference/figures/textbook-cover.jpg)](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-61121-7)

Cover artwork by Springer. Used with permission.

Heterogeneity in Statistical Genetics: How to Assess, Address, and
Account for Mixtures in Association Studies

Derek Gordon, Stephen J. Finch, and Wonkuk Kim. Springer, 2020.

The book explains how mixtures and measurement errors can change a
genetic study’s power. Derek Gordon is a coauthor of both the book and
paweh. The package also draws on other publications for individual
methods.

[Read Methods &
Sources](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/articles/paweh-08-methods-and-sources.md)

## Capabilities and limitations

paweh supports prospective study design using specified effect sizes,
sampling plans, and measurement assumptions. Its sequencing calculations
use planned read depths and error rates. Use separate analysis tools to
process raw sequencing files or run downstream GWAS association tests.

[Cite paweh](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/authors.html#citation)

# Package index

## Case-Control: Main Functions

Estimate power and recruitment for unrelated cases and controls.

- [`cc_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/cc_mssn.md)
  : Case-Control Minimum Sample Size for Conditional Genotype
  Frequencies
- [`cc_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/cc_power.md)
  : Case-Control Power for Conditional Genotype Frequencies

## Case-Control: Misclassification and Heterogeneity

Explore how errors and genetic mixtures change a planned comparison.

- [`cc_chisq_mssn_genotype_misclassification_1p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)
  [`cc_chisq_power_genotype_misclassification_1p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)

  [`cc_chisq_mssn_genotype_misclassification_3p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)
  [`cc_chisq_power_genotype_misclassification_3p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)
  [`cc_chisq_mssn_genotype_misclassification_differential_3p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)
  [`cc_chisq_power_genotype_misclassification_differential_3p()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_genotype_misclassification.md)
  : Specialized Case-Control Genotype Misclassification Functions
- [`cc_chisq_mssn_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  [`cc_chisq_power_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  [`cc_trend_mssn_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  [`cc_trend_power_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  : Specialized Case-Control Locus-Heterogeneity Functions

  [`cc_chisq_mssn_phenotype_misclassification()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/case_control_phenotype_misclassification.md)
  : Specialized Case-Control Phenotype Misclassification Functions

## TDT: Main Functions

Plan a transmission disequilibrium test with affected children and both
parents.

- [`tdt_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_mssn.md)
  : Family-Based (TDT) Minimum Sample Size Necessary
- [`tdt_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_power.md)
  : Family-Based (TDT) Power

## TDT: Specialized Calculations

Work with expected transmissions, genetic models and phenotype
misclassification.

- [`tdt_expected_nontransmission_probability()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_expected_nontransmission_probability.md)
  : Expected Non-Transmission Probability (gNT\*) in the Transmission
  Disequilibrium Test (TDT)
- [`tdt_expected_transmission_counts()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_expected_transmission_counts.md)
  : Expected Transmissions (ET\*) and Non-Transmissions (ENT\*) in the
  Transmission Disequilibrium Test (TDT)
- [`tdt_expected_transmission_probability()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_expected_transmission_probability.md)
  : Expected Transmission Probability (gT\*) in the Transmission
  Disequilibrium Test (TDT)
- [`tdt_mssn_from_model()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_mssn_from_model.md)
  : TDT Minimum Sample Size Necessary from Genetic Model Parameters
- [`tdt_mssn_phenotype_misclassification_from_ncp()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_mssn_phenotype_misclassification_from_ncp.md)
  : TDT Minimum Sample Size Necessary from an NCP under Phenotype
  Misclassification
- [`tdt_power_from_expected_counts()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_power_from_expected_counts.md)
  : Transmission Disequilibrium Test (TDT) Power from Expected
  Transmissions and Non-Transmissions
- [`tdt_power_from_model()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_power_from_model.md)
  : Transmission Disequilibrium Test (TDT) Power from Genetic Model
  Parameters

## Quantitative Traits

Plan analyses of continuous traits, selected extremes and multiple
correlated measurements.

- [`qtl_anova_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_anova_mssn.md)
  : Minimum Sample Size for One-Way ANOVA Under the Falconer Model
- [`qtl_anova_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_anova_power.md)
  : Power for One-Way ANOVA Under the Falconer Model
- [`qtl_falconer_parameters()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_falconer_parameters.md)
  : Falconer Parameters for a Single Quantitative Trait
- [`qtl_falconer_threshold_parameters()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_falconer_threshold_parameters.md)
  : Threshold-Selected Parameters Under the Falconer Model
- [`qtl_multivariate_mssn_full()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_multivariate_mssn_full.md)
  : Multivariate Falconer Minimum Sample Size
- [`qtl_multivariate_power_full()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_multivariate_power_full.md)
  : Multivariate Falconer Power
- [`qtl_threshold_chisq_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_threshold_chisq_mssn.md)
  : Minimum Sample Size for a Threshold-Selected Genotype Chi-Square
  Test
- [`qtl_threshold_chisq_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/qtl_threshold_chisq_power.md)
  : Power for a Threshold-Selected Genotype Chi-Square Test

## Sequencing

Compare sequencing depth and read error assumptions for case-control or
trio designs.

- [`cc_ngs_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/cc_ngs_mssn.md)
  : Analytic MSSN for a Case-Control Sequencing Study
- [`cc_ngs_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/cc_ngs_power.md)
  : Analytic Power for a Case-Control Sequencing Study
- [`ngs_genotype_error_matrix()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/ngs_genotype_error_matrix.md)
  : Sequencing-Derived Genotype Error Matrix
- [`tdt_ngs_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_ngs_mssn.md)
  : Analytic MSSN for a TDT1-NGS Sequencing Study
- [`tdt_ngs_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/tdt_ngs_power.md)
  : Analytic Power for a TDT1-NGS Sequencing Study

## LRTae

Plan studies that verify diagnoses, genotypes or both in a subset of
participants.

- [`lrtae_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/lrtae_mssn.md)
  : Minimum Total Sample Size for an LRTae Design
- [`lrtae_ncp()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/lrtae_ncp.md)
  : Noncentrality Parameter for Prospective LRTae Designs
- [`lrtae_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/lrtae_power.md)
  : Prospective Power for an LRTae Design

## Hardy–Weinberg Equilibrium

Test observed counts or plan a study to detect a specified departure
from equilibrium.

- [`hwe_test()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/hwe_test.md)
  : Test observed genotype counts for Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
- [`hwe_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/hwe_power.md)
  [`hwe_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/hwe_power.md)
  : Plan power and sample size for a Pearson HWE test

## Plotting and Visualization

Show design sensitivity, power, recruitment or genotype distributions.

- [`plot_cc_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_cc_mssn.md)
  : Plot Case-Control Minimum Sample Size Necessary
- [`plot_cc_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_cc_power.md)
  : Plot Case-Control Power
- [`plot_ngs_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_ngs_mssn.md)
  : Plot MSSN Sensitivity for Sequencing Designs
- [`plot_ngs_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_ngs_power.md)
  : Plot Power Sensitivity for Sequencing Designs
- [`plot_qtl_anova_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_qtl_anova_mssn.md)
  : Plot One-Way ANOVA Minimum Sample Size Under the Falconer Model
- [`plot_qtl_anova_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_qtl_anova_power.md)
  : Plot One-Way ANOVA Power Under the Falconer Model
- [`plot_qtl_genotype_distribution()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_qtl_genotype_distribution.md)
  : Plot Falconer Genotype-Specific Quantitative-Trait Distributions
- [`plot_qtl_threshold_chisq_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_qtl_threshold_chisq_mssn.md)
  : Plot Threshold-Selected Genotype Chi-Square Minimum Sample Size
- [`plot_qtl_threshold_chisq_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_qtl_threshold_chisq_power.md)
  : Plot Threshold-Selected Genotype Chi-Square Power
- [`plot_tdt_mssn()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_mssn.md)
  : Plot TDT Minimum Sample Size Necessary
- [`plot_tdt_mssn_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_mssn_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  : Plot TDT MSSN Sensitivity to Locus Heterogeneity
- [`plot_tdt_mssn_phenotype_misclassification()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_mssn_phenotype_misclassification.md)
  : Plot TDT MSSN Sensitivity to Phenotype Misclassification
- [`plot_tdt_power()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_power.md)
  : Plot TDT Power
- [`plot_tdt_power_locus_heterogeneity()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_power_locus_heterogeneity.md)
  : Plot TDT Power Sensitivity to Locus Heterogeneity
- [`plot_tdt_power_phenotype_misclassification()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_power_phenotype_misclassification.md)
  : Plot TDT Power Sensitivity to Phenotype Misclassification
- [`plot_tdt_surface3d()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/plot_tdt_surface3d.md)
  : Plot a Generalized 3D TDT Sensitivity Surface

## Interactive Dashboard

Open the Shiny interface for case-control, trio and quantitative-trait
designs.

- [`paweh_app()`](https://akilanthony.github.io/paweh/reference/paweh_app.md)
  : Construct the paweh Shiny Dashboard
